threshold_policy: Original fitted thresholds and approvals; the separate validation-cohort correction is not applied.

tp_definition.name: true-positive meta-labeling
tp_definition.rule: For a Kronos proposal (pred=1), meta_label=lab=1 iff signed day-7 close return exceeds 0.002; otherwise label 0.
tp_definition.scope: Equivalence checked on all complete-horizon proposals in the 40 daily source CSVs; not just Test.
